title: Billboard Graphic
text:
library(tidyverse)


billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = as.integer,
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25, color = "midnightblue") +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = c(1, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Hot 100 Song Trajectories (2000)",
    subtitle = "Weekly rank progression for songs on the chart",
    x = "Week on Chart",
    y = "Chart Rank",
    caption = "Source: tidyr::billboard"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
